findings.reason: whichever surface a dispatcher reads, one of the two graphs must be corrected or §7 runs on the wrong head and §12's refusal measurement lands on a profile §13 then replaces.
findings.text: the plan's dependency graph is stated twice and disagrees: `plan-section-depends-on` (line 34) records s7<-{s6,s10,s12}, s11<-{s8} and s12<-{s10,s13}, while the section elements record s7<-{s6}, s11<-{} and s12<-{s10}; §7's own text requires §10 ("§7 therefore follows §6, and §10's single-kernel coupling, and is measured on the parent head that carries both"), so a dispatch built from `data-links` runs §7 on a head without the single-kernel coupling, and §12 may run before or after §13 with no ordering even though §13 changes the edge profiles §12's refusals are measured on

findings.reason: a done-when with an unreachable branch sends the node's H200 job at a comparison the plan's own §12 says cannot be formed, so the node burns its allocation and returns a measurement fitting neither branch.
findings.text: §7's clause (2) presumes an "unmasked converged 137D" from which to re-solve, but §12 (line 113) reports that on §7's declared head the identical seed stops at 3.3e-4 with ACTIVE_SET_STEP_REFUSED on the single-kernel coupling; both branches of the disjunction are then unavailable and the job cannot close the node

findings.reason: the section's edge values are the ones §6's edge current rides on, so without an independent surface and a stated tolerance the node can pass its gate with a wrong edge form.
findings.text: §13 clause (2) requires the builder's psiN=1 values to match "that committed extraction to 1e-10 relative" and then checks frame :102 against "the review reading (~-2319.18, ~+0.00584)"; the committed extraction is the builder's own source of those values, so the 1e-10 clause cannot fail on a builder that reads it, and the only independent reading, which line 119 records no committed record holds, is given no tolerance

findings.reason: the node's only durable product is the record §7 never names, so a later reader and §9, which runs on §7's head, have nothing to open.
findings.text: §7 requires an H200 job that "reports the §6 table ... with flux-contour panels" but names no evidence record and no figure directory, unlike §12 and §13 which name both

findings.reason: the section's done-when (1) is satisfied only by a record a reviewer can open, and the path that makes that true is left to the worker.
findings.text: §11 says to run the benchmark entry point "with `--output` under this node's evidence directory" without naming the directory, so the one artifact the node must commit has no declared home
